rationale: Motor vehicle collision causing damage to the policyholder's vehicle and injury to the policyholder.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle was rear-ended on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 AM yesterday; the vehicle is totaled with severe trunk and back-seat damage from an impact at 35 mph. Claimant sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information is documented on the police report.

case_facts.description: Rear-end collision; other driver traveling at 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
